$comment: Narrow, expiring waivers enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Critical advisories can never be waived. Every entry must be re-reviewed before expiresAt.

entries.justification: Metro build-time asset dimension parser. Only project-controlled image assets are parsed; no attacker-supplied image reaches this code at runtime. Upstream has no 1.x fix and the 2.x major breaks Metro 0.81.
entries.remediation: Re-evaluate with the Expo SDK upgrade (explicitly out of V2.1 scope).

entries.justification: Same Metro build-time parser as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq. ICNS input is not accepted from users; assets are repository-controlled.
entries.remediation: Re-evaluate with the Expo SDK upgrade (explicitly out of V2.1 scope).

entries.justification: Reachable only through Expo CLI code-signing and the React Native dev middleware (developer machine). Not bundled into the API, admin, landing, or the exported web build. No patched version exists upstream.
entries.remediation: Track Expo/React Native releases that drop selfsigned/node-forge; upgrade in a dedicated task.

entries.justification: Build-time glob matching in Metro/metro-file-map/jscodeshift. Patterns come from the repository, never from end users. No patched version exists upstream.
entries.remediation: Re-evaluate with the Expo SDK upgrade; remove if micromatch/braces bump becomes available.
